description: How well a recording was captured, from one more decode at the stream's own rate with every channel: EBU R 128 loudness, loudness range, and true peak; clipping at full scale and overs above it; clicks, discontinuities, dropouts, and noise bursts that stand out from the transients around them; mains hum; DC offset, stereo correlation, noise floor, and effective bandwidth.

correlation.description: Pearson correlation of the first two channels in each frames window (Essentia FalseStereoDetector); 1 for a single channel compared with itself, 0 where either channel is below -70 dBFS

peak_db.description: largest sample magnitude of any channel in each frames window, floored at -120

sample_rate.description: the stream's own sample rate, at which everything else here is measured

seconds.description: decoded length at the stream's own rate

integrated.description: EBU R 128 integrated loudness (ffmpeg ebur128); -70.0 is the gate's floor, silence

true_peak.description: true peak, 4x oversampled (ITU-R BS.1770-4, ffmpeg ebur128), floored at -120

sample_peak.description: largest sample magnitude of any channel, floored at -120

full_scale_samples.description: samples, counted per channel, at or beyond 32767/32768 of full scale

clipped_seconds.description: time inside clipped runs (see clipping), summed over channels

dc_offset.description: the mean sample value of the channel whose mean is farthest from zero, as a fraction of full scale

whole_correlation.description: Pearson correlation of the first two channels over the whole recording; 1 for a single channel

anti_phase.description: fraction of windows with both channels above -70 dBFS whose correlation is below zero

false_stereo.description: whether two or more channels carry one signal: whole_correlation at least 0.9995 (Essentia FalseStereoDetector's threshold)

noise_floor.description: 10th percentile of the frames windows' levels (mean square over channels), digital silence excluded

snr.description: 95th percentile of the windows' levels minus the noise floor: a level ratio, not a measured signal and noise

bandwidth.description: frequency above which the long-term spectrum holds no content: where it falls 20 dB within 600 Hz and never comes back; the Nyquist frequency when it does not

band_limited.description: whether bandwidth is below 0.85 of the Nyquist frequency: an upsampled or lossily encoded source; false for digital silence

hum_examined.description: whether hum was looked for: false when the recording is shorter than 20 seconds, so an empty hum list means nothing

clipping.description: flat tops, per channel: runs of samples whose neighbours differ by at most one 16-bit step, either at least 3 samples at or above -0.01 dBFS (full scale), or at least 16 samples (at 48 kHz and below; 32 at 88.2 and 96 kHz, 64 at 176.4 and 192 kHz) within 0.05 dB of the channel's own peak (clipped audio whose gain was changed afterwards); closer than 50 ms joined; value: seconds clipped inside; label: the channel, from 1. A limiter's brief flat tops below full scale are not clipping, nor are clipped runs shorter than 16 samples below it; lossy encoding leaves no flat run, and clipping encoded lossily shows only as overs

overs.description: where the signal between samples, 4x oversampled (a 32-tap Kaiser-windowed sinc per point), or a sample itself reaches 0 dBTP, per channel, closer than 50 ms joined: what a converter or a lossy encoder clips; value: the largest level inside, in dBTP; label: the channel

clicks.description: impulsive noise (Essentia ClickDetector) per channel whose sample-to-sample step exceeds either 16 times its context (the 90th percentile of the largest steps of the 50 ms blocks within 1 s either side, its own block and their neighbours left out) or 6 times what is left of its own block and the two beside it (each chunk of one detector hop, 256 samples at 48 kHz and below, without its largest step and the 4 samples either side, as many more at higher rates as the hop); value: that step, in full scale; label: the channel

discontinuities.description: jumps in the waveform (Essentia DiscontinuityDetector) with prediction error at least 0.05 whose second difference exceeds either 20 times its context (the 90th percentile of the largest second differences of the 50 ms blocks within 1 s either side, its own block and their neighbours left out) or 6 times what is left of its own block and the two beside it (as for clicks); value: the prediction error, in full scale; label: the channel

gaps.description: dropouts, silence of 10 ms to 3.5 s after and before sound (Essentia GapsDetector), per channel; label: the channel

noise_bursts.description: noise bursts (Essentia NoiseBurstDetector) whose second difference reaches 0.001 of full scale and exceeds 30 times its context (as for discontinuities), within 10 ms joined, per channel; value: the largest second difference, in full scale; label: the channel

hum.description: mains hum: a narrow peak within 0.2% of 50 or 60 Hz or a harmonic of either up to 400 Hz, 15 dB above the median of its neighbourhood (15% either side) and not one line of an evenly spaced comb (a loop: local peaks 6 dB above that median and within 20 dB of the peak, d and 2d either side of it), in 8 s windows of the channels' mean every 4 s, with its series' first or second harmonic; kept when it is present in at least two quiet windows (20 dB below the 95th-percentile window level), or lasts at least 20 s and is present in a quiet window, which a recording with no quiet window (a master) is not asked for; value: the peak's median frequency in Hz; times are the windows' bounds
